Bioinformatics Resource Center - Rockefeller University" author: - "[http://rockefelleruniversity.github.io/responsible_use_of_AI_for_noncoders/](http://rockefelleruniversity.github.io/responsible_use_of_AI_for_noncoders/)" - "[brc@rockefeller.edu](mailto:brc@rockefeller.edu)" --- ::: {.content-hidden when-format="revealjs"} # Responsible Use of AI for Non-Coders: What Happens With a Query ::: ## Overview *Presenter: Tom — 45 mins* - [The context window](#the-context-window) - [Where context comes from](#where-context-comes-from) - [Context compression](#context-compression) - [Context, tokens and models](#context-tokens-and-models) - [Exercise](#time-for-an-exercise) # Context {background-color="#23373B" .center .middle} ## The context window The **context window** is everything the model can see when it generates a reply: your messages, its previous replies, and anything else the app has added. The model has no memory outside it. ??Size of typical context windows; what happens when it fills?? ## Where context comes from What you type is only part of what the model sees. Apps add more context, for example: - System prompts written by the app provider - Saved memory and custom instructions - Uploaded files and documents - Results from web searches and other tools ??Examples from ChatGPT / Claude of injected context?? ## Context compression ??How long conversations are summarised or truncated to fit the context window, and why earlier instructions can be lost as a result?? # Tokens {background-color="#23373B" .center .middle} ## Context, tokens and models ??What a token is, how text is split into tokens, and how token count relates to context window size, cost, speed and model choice?? ## Time for an exercise! Exercise on context and tokens can be found [here](../../exercises/exercises/Exercise_ContextTokens_exercise.html) ## Answers to exercise Answers can be found [here](../../exercises/answers/Exercise_ContextTokens_answers.html)
